services.title: Cloud Security Solutions
services.summary: Enterprise-grade cloud protection for secure migration, governance, identity control, compliance readiness, and continuous visibility.
services.overview: Team DRSA helps organizations design and operate secure cloud environments with a practical, risk-aware approach. The engagement is tailored to the client environment, risk profile, compliance needs, and delivery objectives.

faq.question: Can this service work with our existing cloud?
faq.answer: Yes. It can support existing cloud environments, new cloud landing zones, and migration projects.

faq.question: Can we update this page later?
faq.answer: Yes. Service scope, delivery stages, and commercial terms are tailored during discovery and proposal preparation.

services.title: Traditional IT Infrastructure
services.summary: Reliable server, storage, virtualization, backup, endpoint, and infrastructure lifecycle services for business-critical environments.
services.overview: Team DRSA supports physical, virtual, and hybrid infrastructure for organizations that need reliable operations, modernization, resilience, and accountable technical delivery.

faq.question: Is this only for on-premise systems?
faq.answer: No. It can support on-premise, hybrid, and infrastructure modernization projects.

faq.question: Can backup planning be included?
faq.answer: Yes. Backup, disaster recovery, and continuity planning can be included.

services.title: Network Design & Security
services.summary: Secure LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, firewall, VPN, segmentation, monitoring, and network architecture services.
services.overview: Team DRSA provides secure network design for organizations that need stable connectivity, controlled access, and visibility. Delivery can include architecture diagrams, vendor-aligned designs, implementation planning, validation, and operational handover.

faq.question: Can this include firewall policy review?
faq.answer: Yes. Firewall rule review, policy cleanup, and secure access planning can be included.

faq.question: Can this support multi-branch offices?
faq.answer: Yes. It can support branch networks, VPN, SD-WAN, and centralized monitoring.

services.title: IT Consultancy Services
services.summary: Strategic IT assessment, roadmap planning, technology audit, policy design, vendor evaluation, and architecture review.
services.overview: Team DRSA provides independent technology advisory for planning, documentation, executive reporting, audits, governance, architecture review, and digital transformation decisions.

faq.question: Can this service help before a project starts?
faq.answer: Yes. It is useful before software, cloud, infrastructure, or security implementation.

faq.question: Can you prepare professional reports?
faq.answer: Yes. Reports, roadmaps, and technical documentation can be included.

services.title: Custom Software Development
services.summary: Custom web apps, ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms, APIs, automation, dashboards, and AI-ready enterprise systems.
services.overview: Team DRSA builds software around real business workflows. Engagements follow a structured software lifecycle covering requirements, architecture, secure implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, and support.

faq.question: Can this build ERP and CRM systems?
faq.answer: Yes. ERP, CRM, SaaS, dashboards, portals, APIs, and automation systems can be developed.

faq.question: Can it integrate with existing systems?
faq.answer: Yes. APIs, databases, third-party services, and future AI-ready integrations can be supported.

services.title: Request Service
services.summary: A structured way to start a consultation for cloud security, infrastructure, networking, consultancy, or custom software.
services.overview: Clients can use the consultation workflow to submit requirements, select a service area, and begin discovery. Team DRSA can then review the request, contact the client, and progress toward scope and proposal.

faq.question: Can clients request multiple services together?
faq.answer: Yes. A single request can include security, infrastructure, networking, consultancy, and software.

faq.question: What happens after a request?
faq.answer: A discovery discussion is arranged to understand requirements, risk, timeline, and next steps.

services.title: Information & Cybersecurity Solutions
services.summary: Comprehensive information and cybersecurity solutions covering security assessment, governance, network security, endpoint protection, identity security, SIEM, threat detection, vulnerability management, and security monitoring.
services.overview: Team DRSA helps organizations protect their information, infrastructure, applications, users, and digital assets through practical and risk-focused cybersecurity services. Our approach combines technical security controls, monitoring, governance, assessment, and continuous improvement to reduce cyber risk and strengthen organizational security posture.
highlights: Information security assessment and risk analysis
Identity, endpoint, network, and application security

faq.question: What cybersecurity services does Team DRSA provide?
faq.answer: Team DRSA provides cybersecurity assessment, security architecture, network and endpoint security, identity security, Active Directory security, SIEM and monitoring, vulnerability management, risk assessment, governance, and security consultancy services.

faq.question: Can you assess our existing IT infrastructure for security risks?
faq.answer: Yes. We can review existing servers, networks, endpoints, identity systems, security controls, logs, configurations, and operational practices to identify risks and recommend improvements.

faq.question: Can Team DRSA implement SIEM and security monitoring?
faq.answer: Yes. We can help design and implement centralized security monitoring, log collection, SIEM integration, detection rules, alerting, dashboards, and monitoring workflows based on organizational requirements.

faq.question: Can the service include Active Directory security?
faq.answer: Yes. Active Directory security assessment can include identity risks, privileged access, authentication events, security logging, attack-path exposure, monitoring requirements, and detection improvement.
